title: Global Drift Lounge & Side Seating Series
body_html:
Drift brings warmth and a welcoming, contemporary profile to the spaces where people come together.

Drift is a Canadian-made seating series built for the moments collaboration actually happens, from workplace lounges to community spaces in healthcare. Soft seats with contoured backs and arms balance comfort with a clean contemporary line, while four-leg wood and swivel base options add warmth across a wide range of finishes. With lounge chairs, side chairs, bar and counter stools, and task swivel models all sharing one design language, you can specify a whole space in a single look. Available in fabric, leather, or COM and offered here as Low Swivel, Low Four-Leg, Medium Four-Leg, and High Four-Leg models.

Key features

  • Series spans lounge chairs, side chairs, bar and counter stools, and task swivel models for coordinated specifying across a space
  • Soft seat with contoured back and arms balances comfort and a clean contemporary profile
  • Four-leg wood and swivel base options add warmth and are offered in a wide range of popular finishes
  • Optional arm and headrest patches add durability for high-traffic areas
  • Available in fabric, leather, or COM (customer's own material)
  • Tested to exceed ANSI/BIFMA industry standards

Who it’s for

Collaborative workplace lounges, reception areas, and healthcare and community spaces in municipal, education, and hospital environments where coordinated, welcoming seating matters.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
